messages:
raj: Heads-up — we need ENI + IPv6 fallback and accelerator entitlement for a new seed account in ap-southeast-7 (p5/p4d/g5). AWS account: 123456789012. Can infra/networking coordinate before I open the formal requests?

kelsey: Got you. Are we using shared VPC or standalone subnets? Any specific AZs? :thinking:

raj: Shared VPC. Plan is ap-southeast-7a/b. We need enough subnet IPs for ENI-heavy workloads; want IPv6 as a fallback to avoid NATGW exhaustion.

akshat: tagging @cloud-eng — we'll also need ENI pool bump and elastic IP headroom. AWS usually wants AZ-level justification.

cloud-eng: Copy. Please provide desired instance families + counts and expected concurrency. Also confirm account ID again.

raj: Account 123456789012. Requesting: p5d.24xlarge x8, p4d.24xlarge x4, g5.48xlarge x6. Burst fallback to g5.xlarge for cheaper inference.

kelsey: Quick Q: IPv6 primary or fallback only? Dualstack?

raj: Dualstack preferred; IPv6 fallback acceptable as immediate mitigation.

tal: FYI, for ENI/accelerator entitlement increases AWS often asks for sustained concurrent instance numbers, AZ distribution, and network throughput per instance. Include runtime profiles.

raj: Noted. Short profile: concurrent GPUs = 18 peak, expected peak ENIs = 360, steady-state ENIs ~150. Will add to case.

devops-bot: Created support case #CASE-987654321 for account 123456789012 — AWS limit increase request initiated. ETA: 3-5 business days. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?displayId=987654321 :white_check_mark:

akshat: Thanks. Finance needs a cost estimate for approval if we convert to reserved capacity later. @finance-liz can you weigh in?

finance-liz: Looping in finance. Rough back-of-envelope (on-demand): ~$140k/mo for initial pattern. If we reserve some capacity we'll re-run numbers — will need PO for committed spends.

kelsey: Subnet calc done — we need /19 per AZ to give enough ENI headroom. Snippet below.

kelsey: ```
# Subnet sizing
azs = ['ap-southeast-7a','ap-southeast-7b']
per_az = '/19'
# allows ENI headroom and room for tenants
```

raj: Good. Next steps: kelsey to author network doc and attach, akshat to augment support case with instance/runtime details, tal to draft AZ justification, finance to review cost. I'll check back in 48h. :thumbsup:

cloud-eng: Also requesting IPv6 dualstack and accelerated entitlement for the G5 family in the same case to reduce roll cycles.

devops-bot: AWS requested additional justification for p5 counts — they asked for per-workload concurrency and typical run durations.

raj: Adding workloads to case: training jobs (8 p5 concurrent, 8–12h runs), batch inference (10 g5 concurrent, short tasks), devsmoke (2 g5 always-on). Adding those now.

akshat: pinging @support-aws to escalate if no reply in 48h.

support-aws: We're tracking the case and will escalate if AWS requests more detail. :eyes:

kelsey: Internal doc updated with subnet diagram and IP plan: https://redwood.internal/docs/net/ap-southeast-7-subnet-plan

raj: Thanks all. Closing this thread for now — reopen if AWS rejects or asks for more. :wave:
